changelog: Boosted AI voice loudness to broadcast standard (-0.6 dBFS peak normalization & limiter) across Piseth, Sreymom, and VoxCPM2.
Integrated dynamic auto-ducking in timeline Play Preview: original video audio automatically dips to ~30% when AI speech is active.
Implemented FFmpeg sidechain compression auto-ducking during video render/export so background sound smoothly dips under AI dialogues.
Resolved Demucs v4 AI Vocal Separation [WinError 1114] DLL initialization routine error (c10.dll / PyTorch C++ core).
Bundled Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) with silent automated setup in Inno Setup installer.
Integrated proactive auto-injection of VC++ Runtime DLLs (vcruntime140_1.dll, msvcp140.dll) into external PyTorch environments.
Added smart runtime error detection and 1-Click Fix button in Isolate BGM Dialog with instant retry separation.
Fixed Video Export Pipeline Error with robust FFmpeg binary path discovery across system and bundled locations.
Resolved ASS subtitle and Brand Canvas temporary file path issues with absolute path escaping for Windows drive letters.
Added automatic detection for silent videos without audio tracks to prevent FFmpeg filtergraph stream mapping failures.
Upgraded Video Export Error Dialog with responsive sizing, scrollable log view, and one-click 'Copy Error' clipboard button.
Added comprehensive automated logging for export commands and errors (export_error.log).
Enhanced Gemini Chunked Transcribe with intelligent multi-segment processing for long audio/video files.
Integrated VoxCPM2 Tokenizer-Free Multilingual TTS & Voice Cloning engine with custom voice profiles.
